title: Fitness Sellers: How to Photograph Supplements, Equipment, and Apparel That Actually Convert
description: Fitness e-commerce is brutally competitive. Here's the photo workflow that separates real brands from Alibaba resellers.

blocks.text: Fitness is one of the most saturated categories in e-commerce. Same protein powders, same resistance bands, same yoga mats—sold by 1,000 different sellers. What separates the ones making money from the ones drowning?
Photos.
The Fitness Buyer Mindset
Fitness buyers are:

items.text: Community-conscious (they want to belong to a brand tribe)

blocks.text: Your photos need to tap all four.
Product Category Playbooks
Supplements:

items.text: Clean packaging shot on white or brand color

blocks.text: Equipment:
Apparel:

Use edit-photo to remove the background and export a transparent PNG. Create white or branded layout versions with the site's supported main-image workflow or a separate design editor; capture and color correction still need to be handled before or after background removal.
Use Rights-Safe Source Images
Most fitness brands are private label—same product from Alibaba, different logos. Manufacturer photos come watermarked.

If a source image contains a watermark, obtain an unwatermarked file from the rights holder or create your own photo. edit-photo does not remove watermarks, and removing ownership marks without permission can create legal and marketplace risks.
The Ad Creative Requirement
Fitness brands live and die by Meta ads. Your ad creative needs constant variation to fight ad fatigue.
Master workflow:
One shoot → months of ad content.
The Before/After Trap
Before/after photos convert well but violate ad platforms' rules. Be careful. Meta and TikTok both restrict weight-loss and body transformation claims.
Safer: "In-use" photos of people using your equipment or apparel, without transformation implications.
The Brand Consistency Requirement
Open your fitness brand's Instagram grid. Does it look like Gymshark or a random dropshipper?
Every photo should share:

items.text: Same energy (intense vs calm vs premium)
